description: Source code for the Exchange Rate Revaluation document in ERPNext, including methods for validation, account data retrieval, and journal entry creation related to exchange rate revaluation.

classes.name: ExchangeRateRevaluation
classes.description: Represents an exchange rate revaluation document with methods for validation, account data processing, and journal entry creation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the document before saving, primarily setting total gain/loss.

methods.name: set_total_gain_loss
methods.description: Calculates and sets the total gain or loss based on account details.

methods.name: validate_mandatory
methods.description: Ensures that mandatory fields like company and posting date are set.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions when the document is canceled.

methods.name: check_journal_entry_condition
methods.description: Checks if journal entry conditions are met based on account balances.

methods.name: get_accounts_data
methods.description: Retrieves account data related to exchange rate revaluation, including current and new exchange rates.

methods.name: get_accounts_from_gle
methods.description: Fetches account details from General Ledger entries for revaluation.

methods.name: throw_invalid_response_message
methods.description: Displays message if no relevant accounts are found for revaluation.

methods.name: make_jv_entry
methods.description: Creates a journal entry for the exchange rate revaluation, including gain/loss entries.
